headline: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure filed by Haresh D. Ramsingahni in Rama Phosphates Limited under SEBI Takeover Code.
sum: Haresh D. Ramsingahni has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or an intention to acquire control of Rama Phosphates Limited.
detail: The disclosure, filed with NSE on 19 June 2026, is a statement by Haresh D. Ramsingahni under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, which requires acquirers to disclose details of shares/voting rights acquired following a substantial acquisition event. The precise quantum of shares acquired, the mode of acquisition, and whether an open offer has been triggered or exempted are not specified in the Bar & Bench excerpt and require review of the full disclosure document. This filing is a material regulatory event triggering market disclosure obligations and potential open offer liability.
